title: Proton Decay
description: Grand unified theories join quarks and leptons, so even a proton can change into a positron and a pion. Its lifetime is at least 10^34 years - and after the last star, the degenerate era ends when every proton is gone. Unlocks Proton Decay Residue.

puzzle.goal: In a theory that unifies the forces, a heavy boson of mass M_X can turn a quark into a lepton. A proton of mass m_p then decays by exchanging it; the rate is the square of the unified coupling α_G, times m_p⁵ by dimensional analysis, divided by M_X⁴, times a hadronic factor A. Write the proton lifetime (units ħ = c = 1).
puzzle.name: lifetime of the proton in grand unification (dimension-six decay)
puzzle.ask: With A = 1, M_X = M × 10¹⁶ GeV, α_G = α and m_p in GeV (1 GeV⁻¹ = 6.58×10⁻²⁵ s), find τ in units of 10³⁰ years.
puzzle.method: Like muon decay through a W: the amplitude carries 1/M_X², the rate its square, and m_p⁵ makes the dimensions of a rate.
